multiDeviceAuthority.authentication: hmac-sha256 over method, route, time and body with a shared 256-bit key; responses are signed the same way
multiDeviceAuthority.projectIdentity: sha256 of the sorted root commit ids, first 32 hex
multiDeviceAuthority.synchronization: git bundle of the registration commit and its unseen ancestors, verified and merged on the client's default branch
multiDeviceAuthority.idempotency: intentId plus the v7/v9 intent digest; a resent intent returns the original commit
multiDeviceAuthority.localFallback: a device with no client config registers exactly like the v15 broker

compatibility.preserves: v10 and v15 entrypoints, intent formats, receipts and exact-commit behaviour are unchanged
